relations.rationale: Jude's practicing openings has no bearing on when Ivo arrived.
Jude's practice schedule is unrelated to the advisor's brief visit to check attendance.
Jude's eagerness to try a new opening has no bearing on what scoring system the next match uses.
That the match uses the standard rating system is consistent with, but does not establish, that newer members found it confusing.
The scoring system used has no bearing on Nell's promise to schedule a meeting.
Confusion about the rating system among newer members is unrelated to whether games were finished by session's end.
Ivo arriving before Jude says nothing about when Tess arrived relative to Jude.
The advisor's brief visit is directly connected to leaving the scoresheets, supporting that this happened during that visit.
The advisor checking attendance has no bearing on when Tess arrived relative to Jude.
The advisor's brief attendance check is unrelated to whether games were finished by session's end.
The advisor leaving scoresheets is unrelated to whether games remained unfinished.
Xavi being taller than most younger members supports the claim that his height helps him reach the higher shelf.
Xavi's height relative to others has no bearing on whether games were finished by session's end.
Unfinished games at the session's end are unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting.
